name: Third-Party SOC 2 Audit Report
objective: Map external vendor data security control frameworks, trust principle validations, and noted operational exceptions.

attributes.name: Vendor Name
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the audited vendor/service organisation name.

attributes.name: Report Type
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify the report (SOC 2 Type I, SOC 2 Type II).

attributes.name: Audit Period Start
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the start of the audit period.

attributes.name: Audit Period End
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the end of the audit period.

attributes.name: Trust Principles Covered
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract trust service criteria covered (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy).

attributes.name: Opinion
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify the auditor opinion (Unqualified, Qualified, Adverse, Disclaimer).

attributes.name: Noted Exceptions
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract each noted control exception: control area, description, severity.

attributes.name: Number of Exceptions
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the total count of noted exceptions.
